content.rendered: Today is the end of Trimester One!! Tomorrow is a teacher work day and no school for students and we also have the following week off for Thanksgiving Break as well. We will see you back in school on Monday, December 2nd . Have a fabulous week off and Happy Thanksgiving to all of our families. You can read the latest newsletter HERE
